title: Bedsure Heated Blanket Throw with Preheat Function, Soft Flannel (50x60, Grey)
features: Fast & Even Warmth: 6 heating levels and 6 timer settings (1-2-4-6-8-10H) let you enjoy personalized coziness. Advanced longer heating wires provide fast, even warmth.
Safer & More Reliable: ETL and FCC certified with default 8-hour auto shut-off to help prevent overheating.
Preheat Function: Preheat the blanket for toasty warmth, then enjoy longer sessions at a comfortable heat level without constant fiddling.
Softness & Versatile Comfort: 220 GSM flannel top and 200 GSM sherpa backing. When not powered on, it serves as a regular throw blanket. Machine care friendly.
Energy-Saving: 100W power rating designed for standard 120V AC wall outlets—cozy warmth with lower electricity use than traditional space heaters.
Giftable: Great for movie nights, beds, housewarmings, birthdays, or holidays; available in multiple colors and sizes.
